summary: MediaBrowser.Common is Jellyfin's shared runtime-abstraction layer (41 .cs files) — mostly DI/host/plugin/network/ASP.NET interfaces with a small nucleus of genuinely portable pure logic: Crc32, ProviderIdParsers, BaseExtensions (StripHtml/GetMD5), the config-abstraction value/interface types (ConfigurationStore, IApplicationPaths, IConfigurationManager/Factory/IValidatingConfiguration, ConfigurationUpdateEventArgs), and the exception hierarchy. The crypto/password-hashing that this crate is chartered to own does NOT live in MediaBrowser.Common in Jellyfin — it is split across MediaBrowser.Model.Cryptography (PasswordHash, Constants, ICryptoProvider — the PHC-format hash string parse/format value type + trait) and Emby.Server.Implementations.Cryptography.CryptographyProvider (the concrete PBKDF2 KDF impl). Per the port charter, those crypto types are pulled INTO hermit-common and the concrete provider is re-implemented over argon2 (workspace dep, hermit/Cargo.toml:73 `argon2 = "0.5"`) as the default hash method, while retaining PHC-string parse/format + verify-of-legacy-PBKDF2 parity. NOTE: the sibling hermit-model inventory also lists MediaBrowser.Model.Cryptography under its unit 2 (primitives-and-helpers); this is an ownership overlap to resolve at PORT stage — recommend crypto lands in hermit-common (this crate) and hermit-model depends on it, OR the PasswordHash value type lives in hermit-model and only the ICryptoProvider impl (argon2) lives here. Flagged, not silently duplicated. The parity oracle is thin: only Crc32Tests + ProviderIdParserTests ship in Jellyfin.Common.Tests; the crypto oracle (PasswordHashTests, CryptographyProviderTests) lives in the Model/Server.Implementations test projects and MUST be carried over for the crypto surface.

real_cross_project_deps.note: Determined by scanning every non-System `using` across the source tree, NOT the csproj. The csproj declares `FrameworkReference Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` and a ProjectReference to MediaBrowser.Model. The AspNetCore framework ref is DEAD for the portable subset — Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http appears in exactly 2 files (HttpContextExtensions, IApplicationHost/plugin host wiring), all DEFERRED. Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection / .Logging likewise appear only in DEFERRED DI/host/plugin/event machinery.
real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Model: REAL and required. Referenced namespaces: Model.Plugins (7×), Model.Updates (3×), Model.Net (2×), Model.Configuration (2× — BaseApplicationConfiguration, EncodingOptions), Model.Serialization (1×). Almost all references sit in DEFERRED files (plugin/update/config-manager interfaces). For the PORTABLE subset the only Model touch-point is BaseApplicationConfiguration/EncodingOptions in the config-manager interface (itself deferred) — so the portable core has effectively NO hard Model dep. Maps to workspace crate `hermit-model`.
real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Model.Cryptography: REAL for the crypto charter (PasswordHash, Constants, ICryptoProvider) — lives in Model, pulled into this crate per the port assignment (see ownership-overlap note in summary).
real_cross_project_deps.Emby.Server.Implementations.Cryptography: Source of the concrete CryptographyProvider (PBKDF2) — NOT a compile dep of MediaBrowser.Common; carried in for the crypto impl, re-done over argon2.
real_cross_project_deps.Jellyfin.Extensions: 1× reference (BaseExtensions or a deferred file). Maps to workspace crate `hermit-util` (already ported). Trivial.
real_cross_project_deps.Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection: DEFERRED — DI container, no Rust analogue.
real_cross_project_deps.Microsoft.Extensions.Logging: DEFERRED — ILogger; map to `tracing` only where a ported unit needs logging.
real_cross_project_deps.System.Net / System.Net.Sockets / System: std/http machinery used by the DEFERRED Net.* subsystem.

crypto_parity_note: Jellyfin's shipped CryptographyProvider uses PBKDF2 (DefaultHashMethod='PBKDF2-SHA512', DefaultIterations=210000, DefaultSaltLength=16 bytes, DefaultOutputLength=64 bytes; Verify also accepts legacy 'PBKDF2' with SHA1/32-byte). The port is chartered to use argon2 for NEW hashes (DefaultHashMethod becomes 'argon2id' or similar) while PasswordHash.Parse/ToString round-trip parity (PHC-like `$id[$params][$salt[$hash]]`, hex-encoded bytes) MUST be preserved exactly (see PasswordHashTests). Verify() should ideally still validate legacy PBKDF2/PBKDF2-SHA512 hashes for migration; if dropped, that is a deliberate behavior change to flag at PORT. GetIterationsParameter FormatException messages ('missing required iterations parameter' / 'invalid iterations parameter') are asserted verbatim by CryptographyProviderTests.

portable_types.name: Crc32
portable_types.note: Standard CRC-32 (zlib/IEEE, reflected, 0xEDB88320 table). Pure, table-driven. Directly tested (Crc32Tests, 6 cases). Could delegate to `crc32fast` crate but a faithful table port is trivial and matches the oracle exactly.

portable_types.name: ProviderIdParsers
portable_types.kind: static-class -> module fns (try_find_imdb_id / try_find_tmdb_movie_id / try_find_tmdb_series_id / try_find_tvdb_id, each -> Option<&str>)
portable_types.note: Pure span/string scanning; ReadOnlySpan<char> out-params become Option<&str> / Option<(start,len)>. Consts ImdbMinNumbers=7, ImdbMaxNumbers=8, ImdbPrefix='tt'. Heavily tested (ProviderIdParserTests, ~20 cases incl. invalid). Core parity target.

portable_types.name: BaseExtensions
portable_types.note: StripHtml: regex `<(.|\n)*?>` replace+trim (regex crate). GetMD5: MD5 of UTF-16LE (Encoding.Unicode) bytes -> Guid; port with `md-5` + build a uuid/Guid from the 16 bytes preserving .NET Guid byte layout. No dedicated test here — behavioral, keep for callers.

portable_types.name: PasswordHash
portable_types.kind: class -> struct (value type: id:String, parameters:IndexMap<String,String>, salt:Vec<u8>, hash:Vec<u8>) with Parse/ToString
portable_types.note: PHC-like hash-string parse+format, hex byte encoding. Round-trip + error-path parity heavily tested (PasswordHashTests: 8 valid parse cases, 7 roundtrip, 2 null/empty ctor throws, 14 invalid-format throws). ArgumentException on null/empty id. Parameter iteration order is preserved on ToString (use ordered map). PULLED from Model per crypto charter — see ownership-overlap note.

portable_types.name: Constants (Cryptography)
portable_types.note: DefaultSaltLength=16, DefaultOutputLength=64, DefaultIterations=210000. SURFACE as configurable settings (see behavioral_constants_to_surface) — they change with the argon2 switch. PULLED from Model.

portable_types.name: ICryptoProvider
portable_types.note: trait: default_hash_method()->&str, create_password_hash(&[char]/&str)->PasswordHash, verify(&PasswordHash, pw)->bool, generate_salt()/generate_salt(len)->Vec<u8>. PULLED from Model.

portable_types.name: CryptographyProvider
portable_types.kind: class -> struct impl ICryptoProvider (re-implemented over argon2)
portable_types.note: The concrete KDF impl. Original: PBKDF2 create + verify(PBKDF2 SHA1/32 legacy, PBKDF2-SHA512), RandomNumberGenerator non-zero salt. PORT: argon2 for create; keep PHC parse/verify parity + the two FormatException message strings + NotSupportedException on unknown id (CryptographyProviderTests, 11 cases). NOT originally in MediaBrowser.Common — carried in per charter.

portable_types.name: ConfigurationStore
portable_types.note: { Key:String, ConfigurationType:Type }. The .NET `Type` field is runtime reflection — model as a type-key String / TypeId or drop the field; portable value shell only. Untested.

portable_types.name: ConfigurationUpdateEventArgs
portable_types.note: { Key:String, NewConfiguration:object }. EventArgs base is a .NET event idiom; port as a plain payload struct (NewConfiguration -> generic or serde_json::Value). Untested; keep only if the config-manager surface is ported.

portable_types.name: IApplicationPaths
portable_types.note: Pure path getters (ProgramDataPath, WebPath, DataPath, PluginsPath, CachePath, LogDirectoryPath, ConfigurationDirectoryPath, TempDirectory, etc.) + MakeSanityCheckOrThrow/CreateAndCheckMarker. App-paths abstraction the charter calls out. Trait of &str/PathBuf getters; the two mutating methods touch the filesystem (std::fs). No concrete impl ships in this project (BaseApplicationPaths lives in Emby.Server.Implementations) — flag whether to also port a default impl at PORT.

portable_types.name: IConfigurationManager
portable_types.note: Config-store registry + save/replace + events. Depends on Model.BaseApplicationConfiguration + IApplicationPaths + IConfigurationFactory. The `event EventHandler<...>` members and `object`/`Type`-typed get/save are .NET-idiomatic — port a trimmed trait (get/save by key over serde types) or defer. BORDERLINE: portable interface shape, but its natural impl is runtime machinery. Includes ConfigurationManagerExtensions.GetConfiguration<T> (generic downcast helper).

portable_types.name: IConfigurationFactory
portable_types.note: GetConfigurations() -> IEnumerable<ConfigurationStore>. Small; portable trait. Untested.

portable_types.name: IValidatingConfiguration
portable_types.note: Validate(old, new) hook. Trivial portable trait. Untested.

portable_types.name: ResourceNotFoundException
portable_types.note: Plain Exception subclass. Port as a hermit-common error variant. Untested.

portable_types.name: MethodNotAllowedException
portable_types.note: Plain Exception subclass (HTTP 405-ish). Untested; keep only if HTTP surface warrants.

portable_types.name: RequiresSourceSerialisationAttribute
portable_types.note: C# marker attribute for a source-generator/serialization concern; no Rust runtime analogue. Likely DROP — listed portable only because it is a trivial standalone type. Reclassify to deferred if it has no consumer in the ported subset.

deferred.name: IApplicationHost
deferred.reason: DI application-host abstraction (service resolution, plugin/assembly discovery, restart/shutdown, GetExports<T>). Reflection + Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection; no Rust analogue. Runtime composition root.

deferred.name: Plugins.* (BasePlugin, BasePluginOfT, IPlugin, IHasPluginConfiguration, IPluginAssembly, IPluginManager, LocalPlugin, PluginManifest)
deferred.reason: Assembly-loading plugin subsystem — Reflection, AssemblyLoadContext, DI, IServiceCollection. Fundamentally runtime/reflection machinery. PluginManifest is a serializable DTO (could port as a struct if a plugin catalog is ever needed) but the manager/base-plugin surface is not portable.

deferred.name: Net.* (INetworkManager, NetworkConfiguration, NetworkConfigurationFactory/Store, NetworkConfigurationExtensions, NetworkConstants, NetworkUtils, NamedClient, RemoteAccessPolicyResult)
deferred.reason: Network-interface enumeration / IP subnet / bind-address management. System.Net.NetworkInformation + IPNetwork + ASP.NET config. Host-networking machinery; NetworkUtils has pure IP math that could be selectively ported later but is out of the config/app-paths/crypto charter.

deferred.name: Extensions.HttpContextExtensions
deferred.reason: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext helpers (IsLocal, GetNormalizedRemoteIP). Web-framework-specific; no analogue outside an ASP.NET pipeline.

deferred.name: Extensions.ProcessExtensions
deferred.reason: System.Diagnostics.Process.WaitForExitAsync polyfill. OS-process machinery; if ever needed, tokio::process handles this natively — no port.

deferred.name: Events.EventHelper
deferred.reason: .NET EventHandler / delegate marshalling + ILogger. C# event-model idiom with no Rust analogue.

deferred.name: Configuration.EncodingConfigurationExtensions
deferred.reason: Extension methods over IConfigurationManager returning Model.EncodingOptions + transcode path. Thin glue over the deferred config-manager runtime + Model config types; port only if/when the config-manager surface is ported.

deferred.name: Updates.* (IInstallationManager, InstallationEventArgs, InstallationFailedEventArgs)
deferred.reason: Plugin package install/update orchestration (HttpClient downloads, events, Model.Updates DTOs). Runtime update subsystem, out of charter.

deferred.name: Api.Policies
deferred.reason: ASP.NET authorization policy-name string constants. Web-auth-framework-specific; if needed, becomes plain string consts elsewhere.

cases.detail: Compute_Empty_Zero (empty->0); Compute_Valid_Success (1: ascii 'The quick brown fox...'->0x414fa339); Compute_ValidHex_Success (4: hex-decoded inputs incl. all-zero->0x190a55ad, all-FF->0xff6cab0b, 00..1F->0x91267e8a).

FindImdbId_Valid_Success (9: tt+7/8 digits, imdb urls, multiline, trailing junk, truncation to 8); FindImdbId_Invalid_Success (3: 6 digits, url w/6 digits, 'Jellyfin'); FindTmdbMovieId Valid(2)/Invalid(2); FindTmdbSeriesId Valid(2)/Invalid(2); FindTvdbId Valid(2)/Invalid(2). out-param + bool return -> Option<&str>.

crypto_oracle_external.note: The crypto surface this crate is chartered to own is tested in OTHER Jellyfin test projects — carry these over as the parity oracle for the crypto port.

files.detail: Ctor_Null throws ArgumentNullException; Ctor_Empty throws ArgumentException; Parse_Valid_Success (8 TheoryData rows: id / id+param / id+params / id+hash / id+salt+hash / id+param+hash / id+params+hash / id+params+salt+hash — asserts Id, Parameters, Salt, Hash, ToString roundtrip); ToString_Roundtrip_Success (7); Parse_Null + Parse_Empty throw ArgumentException; Parse_InvalidFormat_ThrowsFormatException (14 malformed strings). This is the highest-value oracle in the crate — exact PHC parse/format parity.

CreatePasswordHash returns id+iterations+salt+hash (ASSERTS id=='PBKDF2-SHA512' — MUST update expectation to the argon2 id after port); Verify valid->true; Verify wrong->false; Verify PBKDF2 & PBKDF2-SHA512 missing-iterations -> FormatException('missing required iterations parameter'); invalid-iterations -> FormatException('invalid iterations parameter'); unknown id -> NotSupportedException; GenerateSalt non-empty; GenerateSalt(len) 16/32/64 length. Fixture: `_sut = new CryptographyProvider()`.
files.port_caveat: Tests that hardcode 'PBKDF2-SHA512' and the PBKDF2 verify path are PBKDF2-specific; under the argon2 port, either (a) keep legacy PBKDF2 verify for migration and adjust CreatePasswordHash's id assertion, or (b) rewrite these cases for argon2. Flag at PORT — do not silently pass by re-hardcoding.

xunit_oracle.fixtures: No JSON/binary fixture files for this crate; all oracle data is inline attributes.

behavioral_constants_to_surface: Crypto Constants.cs: DefaultSaltLength=16 bytes, DefaultOutputLength=64 bytes, DefaultIterations=210000 (PBKDF2). Under the argon2 switch these map to argon2 params (memory cost, time cost/iterations, parallelism, salt len, output len) — surface ALL as configurable settings with sensible argon2id defaults rather than hardcoding; the PBKDF2 iteration count is meaningless for argon2.
CryptographyProvider legacy verify: PBKDF2 SHA1/32-byte and PBKDF2-SHA512/64-byte parameters — only relevant if legacy-hash migration is retained.
ProviderIdParsers: ImdbMinNumbers=7, ImdbMaxNumbers=8 (IMDb id digit bounds) — domain constants, likely keep as named consts (not user settings).
BaseExtensions.GetMD5 uses UTF-16LE (Encoding.Unicode) input — a semantic invariant, not a tunable; preserve exactly for hash stability.
needs_external_crate: argon2 (workspace dep, hermit/Cargo.toml:73 `argon2 = "0.5"`) — the chartered KDF for CryptographyProvider create/verify.
password-hash / rand_core (argon2's PHC + RNG traits) OR `rand` for salt generation (GenerateSalt).
hex or use argon2/base16 — PasswordHash byte<->hex (Convert.FromHexString/ToHexString, UPPERCASE) for PHC-string round-trip.
indexmap OR a Vec<(String,String)> — PasswordHash.Parameters must preserve insertion order for ToString parity (C# Dictionary iteration order relied on by tests).
uuid (BaseExtensions.GetMD5 returns a Guid — build from 16 MD5 bytes preserving .NET Guid layout) — only if GetMD5 is ported.
thiserror — port the exception hierarchy (ResourceNotFound/RateLimitExceeded/MethodNotAllowed/Ffmpeg + crypto FormatException/NotSupported) as error enum variants.
crc32fast (OPTIONAL) — could replace the hand-ported Crc32 table; a faithful table port needs no crate and matches the oracle.

hermit-model (workspace) — only if the config-manager/EncodingConfiguration surface is ported (BaseApplicationConfiguration/EncodingOptions); the portable core (crc32/providerid/crypto/exceptions) does NOT need it.
hermit-util (workspace, already ported) — the single `Jellyfin.Extensions` reference maps here.
